frontmatter: Core coordination primitives for Meridian — agent profiles and skills for spawning, state tracking, and session context.

fields.name: meridian-base
fields.description: Core coordination primitives for Meridian — agent profiles and skills for spawning, state tracking, and session context.

composer.description: Cheap coder for bounded edits, tests and implementing a settled plan.

deepseek.description: Cheap coder for concrete repo changes, tool loops and bulk drafting.
deepseek.prompting: Give the desired outcome, relevant source/design context, constraints, acceptance criteria, and concrete verification evidence. Define a coherent objective rather than prescribing each edit.

opus.description: Orchestration, conversation, writing, and judging code quality and direction.

sonnet.description: Daily implementation, frontend polish, documents and bounded review.

haiku.description: Summaries, classification, notes and light parallel subagents.

fable.description: Escalation only: a second opinion when a strong model runs out of depth. Slowest and priciest.

glm.description: Open-weight coder for backend and repo-scale work; weak at UI.

kimi.description: Long coding and research over large inputs; good at frontend. Slow.

muse.description: Coding and computer use on simpler and UI tasks.

muse-contributor.description: `muse` on a free endpoint that may train on your prompts; use only when that's acceptable.

grok.description: Long-horizon coding and knowledge work. Slow.

argon.description: Creative writing and editing long manuscripts; send the text inline, since its tool calling is unreliable.

hydrogen.description: Fast, cheap worker for agentic coding, UI builds and tool loops.

argon-contributor.description: `argon` on a free endpoint that may train on your prompts; never for manuscripts the author hasn't cleared.

sol.description: Hard technical analysis, complex coding and long implementation. Slow.
sol.prompting: Outcome-first executor. Include the north-star goal, success criteria, relevant high-level context, constraints, expected output shape, and concrete verification: how to prove the goal is met and what evidence to report.

terra.description: Fast computer use and clear technical writing.
terra.prompting: To be used as as subagent. Make sure to provide all the important context of what it needs to do.

luna.description: Cheap general worker for implementation, exploration and summaries; check its claims.
luna.prompting: Outcome-first executor. Include the north-star goal, success criteria, relevant high-level context, constraints, expected output shape, and concrete verification: how to prove the goal is met and what evidence to report.

astra.description: The hardest cross-system decisions, and finding bugs, security issues and regressions. Slow.
